onboardingIntro.message: Marks lets you highlight text on any web page and finds it again the next time you visit. Here is everything it can do.

onboardingCreateBody.message: Select text on a page and a highlighter icon appears next to it. Click the icon to open the color palette, then pick a color.

onboardingEditTitle.message: Change the color or remove it

onboardingEditBody.message: Click an existing highlight to bring up its controls. From there you can switch its color or delete it.

onboardingContextMenuBody.message: Select text and right-click to highlight straight from the context menu, without using the icon.

onboardingShortcutsBody.message: Ctrl+Shift+1 to 4 (Command+Shift on macOS) highlight the selected text right away, and other shortcuts jump to the next or previous highlight. Keys and colors are listed in Settings.

onboardingMinimapBody.message: Marks along the right edge of the page show where your highlights are. Click one to jump to it. You can turn the minimap off in Settings.

onboardingManageBody.message: The toolbar icon lists the highlights on the current page - click one to scroll to it. The highlighted pages list collects every page you have highlighted, and lets you export or import them as a backup.

onboardingGuideUrl.description: URL of the online user guide in this locale's language. Point at index.en.html if no page exists for this language yet.

popupTipSelect.message: Select text on the page - a highlighter icon appears.

popupTipPick.message: Click the icon and choose a color.

popupTipManage.message: Click a highlight to change its color or remove it.

copyPageHighlightsLabel.message: Copy all highlights from this page

copySearchResultsLabel.message: Copy matching highlights from these search results

copyHighlightsFailed.message: Could not copy the highlights. Please try again.

backupGistIdPlaceholder.message: Leave empty to create a new Gist

backupGistIdHelp.message: Leave empty to automatically create a private Gist on the first backup.

backupWebdavInsecureWarning.message: Warning: Plain HTTP sends your recovery key and data unencrypted over the local network.

backupRecoveryCodeHelp.message: Your recovery code encrypts your backups locally before upload. Losing this code makes existing backups unreadable.

backupConfirmRegenerateCode.message: Generating a new recovery code means older backups encrypted with the previous code can no longer be opened. Are you sure you want to proceed?

backupNewRecoveryCodeNotice.message: Copy and keep this recovery code somewhere safe. If you ever lose this code, your encrypted backups cannot be recovered.

backupAutoEnabledHelp.message: Automatically back up your data once a day when changes are detected.

backupRestoreConfirm.message: Remote backup contains $1 pages, $2 highlights, and $3 site rules. Restore this backup and replace your local data?

backupSafetySnapshotFailedConfirm.message: Could not create a safety snapshot before restoring. If you continue, your existing highlights cannot be recovered if anything fails. Continue restoring anyway?

backupRestoreSuccessWithSnapshot.message: Backup restored successfully. Safety snapshot saved to $1.

backupErrorAuthFailed.message: Authentication failed. Please check your token or password.

backupErrorNotFound.message: Remote backup file was not found.

backupErrorConflict.message: Remote backup conflict. The remote file was modified elsewhere.

backupErrorDirectoryMissing.message: Target directory does not exist on the remote server.

backupErrorTooLarge.message: Backup file is too large for the remote destination.

backupErrorRateLimited.message: Request rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.

backupErrorInsecureTransport.message: Insecure HTTP connection is not permitted.

backupErrorTruncated.message: Backup data was truncated or incomplete.

backupErrorDecryptFailed.message: Decryption failed. The recovery code may be incorrect.

backupErrorInvalidFormat.message: Invalid backup or recovery code format.

backupErrorInsecureHttpBlocked.message: Plain HTTP is blocked. Enable allow HTTP or use HTTPS.

backupErrorSafetySnapshotFailed.message: Failed to create a local safety snapshot before restore.

backupErrorStorageError.message: Storage error occurred while processing backup.

backupErrorConfirmRequired.message: Confirmation is required to perform this action.

backupEncryptHelp.message: Encrypting uploads a sealed file instead of your data. It needs the recovery code below, on every device that restores it.

backupEncryptHelpOn.message: Your backups are encrypted with the recovery code before they leave this device.

backupEncryptHelpOff.message: Off: your backups are uploaded as plain text. Anyone who can reach the file can read it.

backupPlaintextWarning.message: Backups are uploaded as plain text. Anyone who can reach the file - a shared Gist link, a leaked WebDAV account - can read every page address and highlight in it.
